oracle_text: Whenever a land you control enters from anywhere other than your hand or you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand, create a 3/3 red Spawn creature token.
examples_from_frozen_99: Fetch land play from hand itself does not trigger; its searched typed land enters from library and triggers if Lost enchantment is already on battlefield
Abaddon commander cast from command zone triggers, provided Lost controlled then; recasts also qualify
Abaddon-granted or printed cascade nonhand exile cast triggers; Underworld Breach escaped spell from graveyard triggers
The Ruinous Powers lets pilot cast opponent spell from exile, triggering Lost and Ruinous owner-life loss separately
limitations: Oracle-condition fixture, NOT observed 3/3 token counts or cast event probabilities
No claim all seven fetches resolve after Lost, or all stolen exiled spells can be cast
No comparison of real-game value of Lost versus Chaos Warp
